lines.text: Anis feels like she's dreaming.
Arkrian Hall is packed to the brim with humans and Nikkes alike.
A massive stage stretches out before her,
and on it, Pretty commands the room with an almost overwhelming presence.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wow...
Anis is certain of it.
The first concert she's ever seen will be the best of her life.
Oswald stares at the worn leather gloves in the display case.
Red Hood's messy signature is barely legible now.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... Could this be another connection forged by Red Hood?

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I owe her in more ways than one.
The TV hums in the background, broadcasting nonstop coverage of Pretty's comeback concert.
No matter which channel he flips to, it's all the same.
Oswald gazes at the ticket in his hand, lost in thought.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to be a bad father, just this once.
Oswald straightens his outfit.
*Thud*
Something hard presses against his chest.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: ... I won't need this.
He pulls out his handgun and sets it inside the drawer.
Ticket in hand, he steps out the front door.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Everyone! Are you having fun?
The audience erupts in cheers.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Phew! I haven't moved this hard in ages! I'm a little out of breath!

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Let me just stand here and chat for three minutes, then we'll jump right back in! Sound good?
Another raucous wave of cheers sweeps over the venue.
On stage, Freesia launches into some light banter.
Honed by countless variety shows, her words flow effortlessly, leaving the audience hanging on every line.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... She's incredible.
Spellbound, Anis watches Pretty on stage, hanging on every word.
Then, she notices something off about the three figures ahead of her. Their movements are strange.
The crowd in the stands is shrouded in darkness, making it hard to see clearly. Even so, Anis doesn't take her eyes off them.
They fumble, searching for something.
One pulls a metal rod from their coat.
Another retrieves a heavy-looking chunk of metal.
The last moves with practiced precision, assembling the pieces together.
A flash of light.
The completed object catches a faint glow for a moment, its outline glimmering in the dimness.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... What?
All at once, Anis realizes that what they've assembled is a gun.
Anis charges forward, but the crowd is packed too tightly. She can barely move.
Still, she forces her way through.
Slowly, a path begins to open.
She pushes harder, closing in on the three figures.
Just a little more, and she can stop them.
In that instant, the person in the center jumps up
and raises the gun,
aiming straight at the stage.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Ahhhhh!
A chill runs down Oswald's spine.
A sound you'd never expect to hear at a concert reaches his ears.
It was the sharp clicks and clanks of a gun being assembled.
Oswald lunges toward it, heart hammering.
Up ahead, he spots the three acting suspiciously.
His hand slips into his jacket.
It's empty. He left it at home.
Without thinking, he tears forward.
In that instant, the person in the center jumps up
and raises the gun,
aiming straight at the stage.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... All right, everyone! Next time you see a Nikke, make sure you greet her with a smile, okay?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: They're the Goddesses of Victory,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: who put their lives on the line for us!
The crowd explodes into cheers.
At the same time,
someone vaults onto a folding chair.
Freesia catches sight of a dark circle aimed at her.
A gun barrel.
Then a flash erupts from its mouth.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You can't be serious...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Oh, but I am. No matter how I look at it, this is the only way.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No hero lasts forever; every star falls, every symbol breaks.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Time, people, the world itself... None of them will just leave you be.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But there's one way to change that.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: One way to remain a symbol who never falls from grace, who never breaks.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... Absolutely not. You think I'd entertain that for a second?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Come on, Mrs. Miss, you know exactly what I mean.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm going to give it everything I've got, harder than ever before.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'll push myself so far that even at my peak, no one could compare. I'll become a superstar no one can even touch.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But I'll need your help, more than ever.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I can do this. This time, there's a real finish line.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: And when I reach the very top, I'll hold a concert.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Something big will happen. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: And on that day, in that place,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'll shine forever.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Why are you telling me this?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Please...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: find the next star.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I won't shine forever. Even the brightest light fades with time.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Before mine does, I need you to discover who will shine next.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: The Ark's new star.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: That's something only you can do, Mrs. Miss.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: We... no, I've

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: created a monster.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I never meant to drag you into this.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: It just hit me.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: You're the first and last teacher I'll ever have.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Ah, a bullet.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: That's the thing flying at me, huh?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Back when I was human, I only ever saw a flash. Never the bullet itself.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: So that's what a bullet really looks like. Crazy that something so small can kill someone.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: It's slow, though. I can dodge it easily.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Maybe I can even catch it.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But a normal Nikke probably can't pull that off.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Oh right, Dad mentioned something about Liliweiss in the hallway the other day...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Maybe I really do have a knack for combat. If I'd become a Nikke sooner, could I have ended up like the Goddesses?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But what if it hits me and I'm fine?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No, no, it's okay. I swapped to a lighter frame and made sure the area around my forehead is fragile.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Let's see... At this angle, it'll hit my neck. Better shift a little.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Yeah, this position's good.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm kind of amazing, huh? Dodging bullets and everything.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Okay, that's enough. This is it.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No matter how I think about it, this is the only way.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'd be lying if I said I don't have any lingering feelings.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But I don't regret this.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I leave the rest to you... Mrs. Miss.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Hanson... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... Dad,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Thank you for being my dad.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I was really, truly happy.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Goodbye.
Pretty crumples to the floor.
A chorus of shrieks ricochets off the walls.
People shove and scramble for the exits as the venue spirals into chaos.
Meanwhile, Anis charges the Nikkephobes and grabs one around the waist.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Aaaahhh! Aarghhh!
She lets out a raw, desperate scream and refuses to release her grip.
The butt of a gun slams into the back of Anis's neck.
Her body goes limp, and she drops hard to the floor.
The fleeing crowd does not look down
and tramples past her in their panic.
Oswald barrels into the Nikkephobes and grapples with them,
but his alcohol-wrecked body won't respond fast enough.
They shove him aside and slip into the chaos of the escaping crowd.
He struggles back to his feet
and heads for the stage, compelled to see the truth for himself.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Freesia.
She lies motionless on the stage.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Mr... Oswald...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Freesia.
Oswald pulls Freesia into his arms.
In that instant, he understands everything she was trying to do.
A storm of grief and pride surges through him.
Even so, he...

lines.speaker: osward_casual
lines.text: Ahhhh... no...
All he can do is let his grief spill out.
Pretty was shot and killed during her comeback concert.
The three suspects are arrested within twenty minutes and identified as extreme Nikkephobes.
They confess that they committed the crime to halt the rising influence of the Nikke Rights Committee, the very organization that had backed Pretty.
After their confession, their whereabouts are never revealed.
The world reels at the truth: a symbol of the Nikkes and the Ark's star has been murdered by Nikkephobes.
Within the Ark, the Nikkephobes become targets of absolute condemnation, and their influence collapses almost overnight.
At the same time, Nikke rights begin to rise sharply.
Enikk enacts new legislation, making the mistreatment of Nikkes a punishable crime.
Thus, Pretty leaves a lasting mark on the Ark,
remaining an idol and a revered figure forever.
Hanson walks through the streets.
Up ahead, a citizen presses an empty can into the hand of a Nikke walking down the street.
The last of its contents already drained.
All of a sudden, someone steps in and knocks the can away.
Hanson keeps moving.
The Nikkes stationed at the public facility stand guard, their uniforms disheveled and their bodies worn and battered.
A group of students lingers nearby, snickering as they hurl scraps of food at them for sport.
The Nikkes don't react. They don't even flinch.
Moments later, the students are detained by the A.C.P.U.
Hanson continues down the street.
In a dark corner of the park, a mass-produced Nikke is getting pummeled, her body swaying with each hit.
It isn't supposed to hurt. The attackers wield nothing but cheap plastic rods and their own hands, hardly enough to cause real damage.
But that Nikke's face twists in pain.
Citizens step forward, confronting the attackers.
Meanwhile, someone supports the Nikke, offering words of comfort.
Hanson keeps walking down the street.
He passes a shop where a Nikke stands awkwardly at the entrance.
The owner refuses to sell to her. She fidgets in place, unsure whether to plead or leave.
In the shop next door, the owner beckons her over.
He passes her the goods and holds both her hands gently but firmly.
Hanson keeps walking.
A little farther on, a drunken man uses a Nikke as a target for his slurred abuse.
Someone steps in to fight on her behalf.
Another is subjected to crude jeers and harassment.
Someone steps forward to help report it.
One stands rigid as someone spits in her face.
Someone throws a punch in response.
And then...
a citizen breaks down in front of another Nikke and shouts,
"It's because you lost that we ended up like this!"
The Nikke lowers her head like a criminal awaiting judgment, simply enduring it without protest.
Hanson steps forward and yells at the screaming citizen,
"It's thanks to these Nikkes putting their lives on the line that we're alive today!"
Hanson finds a quiet spot in the far corner of the park and sits down.
His tears fall.
He weeps over and over, lost in his sorrow.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Freesia...!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Goddammit,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: the plan's fallen apart.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You're telling me you had no clue until it blew up?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Explain yourself, Producer.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: How would I know?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You damn well should have!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Do you have any idea how much money I poured into this?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And my position! My damn position! What are you going to do about it?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... You really don't care about anyone but yourself.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Spare me the lecture and tell me what you're going to do about this!

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'm done.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I can't do this anymore.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You heard me, I quit.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Do you... even know what you're saying...?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Did I stutter?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Ah... uh...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And what, you got some other way to make a living?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I've got plenty of money, though it's money I earned while you treated me like dirt.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I will find them, mark my words.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Find who?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: And there's nothing you can do to stop me.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Live long, you miserable piece of trash.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Ah... uh...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hah!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go on, scram! I don't need anyone,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: least of all you...! Hahaha!
*Bzzz*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Damn it. Can't they leave me alone for five seconds?
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Yes, it's me.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I apologize for what happened with Pretty. There were... complications.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Sorry, what?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Her body?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Well... yes, it's still there. It's been delayed because of the funeral and all that.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why would you need it?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: No, I don't have a use for it, but...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: All right, I understand.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'll take care of it. If that's all you need, there's no reason for me to refuse.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: See you then. Yes.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Thank you.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Thanks, Pretty. Even in death, you've got your uses.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hahahaha...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Now that's... entertainment!
With a soft click,
Oswald returns home and switches on the lights.
He starts preparing a meal.
Two plates are set neatly on the table.
After eating, Oswald settles onto the couch
and plays Freesia's performance.
He keeps watching
until he drifts off to sleep.
He wakes up
to find it's his day off.
The performance plays again.
He remains absorbed,
watching until sleep claims him once more.
For Oswald, time has stopped.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: So I've become a Nikke...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... You're awake.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wait... you're Pretty's manager...?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I see you know who I am.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah, I've seen you on TV a few times.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: How's Pretty doing?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Ah, okay.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Five people lost their lives at the concert.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Of those, the women whose brains were intact were taken in by Tetra Line and turned into Nikkes.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're one of them.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Your name is Anis, right?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I heard what you did for Pretty at the park.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You have my thanks.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: How'd you know about that?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Because there was a fool who could do nothing but watch from a distance.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Someone who couldn't bring himself to comfort her, to stand against anyone.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Sorry, that probably came out kind of strange.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Anis,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: have you ever thought about becoming a pop star?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The Ark needs stars

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: like Pretty.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'll give it a shot.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I really want to.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I want to be a star

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: that gives people hope.
PRETTY STAR: END
